question.text: The heat radiated per unit area in 1 hour by a furnace whose temperature is $3000 \mathrm{~K}$ is $(\sigma=5.7 \times$ $10^{-8} \mathrm{~W} \mathrm{~m}^{-2} \mathrm{~K}^{-4}$ )

solution.text:
According to Stefan's law
$$
E=\sigma T^4
$$
Heat radiated per unit area in 1 hour ( $3600 \mathrm{~s})$ is
$$
=5.7 \times 10^{-8} \times(300)^4 \times 3600=1.7 \times 10^{10} \mathrm{~J}
$$
